Maya T: FYI we're finalizing the on‑prem marketplace correction policy. Need agreement on duplicate detection + late claim windows before partner docs.
Jorge R: TL;DR: 48h fast dedupe + 30d durable index, auto-apply corrections within 5d, manual review after.
Nina C: Billing needs exact ledger line format: `correction|orig_event_id|units_delta|amount_delta|reason`. That way partner statements can reconcile automatically.
Tom H: Ingestion note: require `idempotency_key` from partners. Fallback canonical: sha256(customer:device:ts). Pseudocode: `cid = id or sha256(...)` then check cache/index.
Maya T: Communication: publish partner FAQ with examples (duplicate retry, corrected payload with `correction=true`, late resend).
Jorge R: Also enforce UTC for all timestamps and keep audit records immutable.
billing-bot: queued adjustment job for staging partner test at 2024-10-10T12:00:00Z.
Maya T: Good — I'll draft the partner notice and PR the runbook. Please ack or add objections.
